title: Focused Practice
passage: Focused practice is not simply repetition. Learners improve faster when they notice an error, understand why it happened, and try a corrected response soon afterwards.

questions.explanation: 文章强调发现错误后尽快订正。

title: Sleep and Memory
passage: Sleep supports memory by helping the brain reorganize newly learned information. A short review before sleep may therefore be more useful than adding another hour of distracted study.

questions.explanation: 睡眠帮助大脑重组新信息。

title: Community Gardens
passage: Community gardens provide more than fresh food. They create shared spaces where neighbors exchange skills, discuss local concerns, and develop a stronger sense of responsibility for their surroundings.

questions.explanation: 社区花园增强共同责任感。
